name: abfall-app
description: Technischer Projektstart für Phase 1 der Abfall APP

scripts.build: pnpm contracts:check && pnpm --filter @waste/design-tokens build && pnpm --filter @waste/web build && pnpm --filter @waste/admin build && ./gradlew :services:api:bootJar
scripts.contracts:check: pnpm contracts:lint && pnpm --filter @waste/api-client generate:check && pnpm --filter @waste/api-client test
scripts.lint: pnpm contracts:lint && pnpm --filter @waste/ui lint && pnpm --filter @waste/web lint && pnpm --filter @waste/admin lint && ./gradlew spotlessCheck
scripts.test: pnpm ci:validate && pnpm contracts:check && pnpm --filter @waste/design-tokens test && pnpm --filter @waste/ui test && pnpm --filter @waste/web test && pnpm --filter @waste/admin test && ./gradlew test integrationTest
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @waste/api-client typecheck && pnpm --filter @waste/ui typecheck && pnpm --filter @waste/web typecheck && pnpm --filter @waste/admin typecheck && ./gradlew :services:api:compileKotlin :services:api:compileTestKotlin
